# Unsuccessful Search

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Unsuccessful Search

Suppose we have to find the index of element 20 (the target value) in the given vector.

![Unsuccessful Search](data:image/png;base64,)

In this case, the linear search algorithm checks each element one by one.

The element 20 is not present in the vector, so the algorithm ends after reaching the end of the vector. This is called an unsuccessful search.
